issues.where: globe surface and white clouds across crops S, T, U, V (also image-05.png globe, image-06.png crops A, D, E, H, and image-07.png crops N, O, P)
issues.what: the close-up planet texture is heavily stretched and blurry with directional smearing across the cyan bands, and the white clouds break apart into visible horizontal rectangular pixel blocks and stepped streaks in crop U
issues.fix: replace the low-resolution spherical planet and cloud maps with higher-resolution pole-free textures or 3D procedural volumetric cloud detail that stays sharp at close camera distance

issues.where: inner and outer ring arcs in crops A, F, and G (also image-05.png upper-center rings and image-07.png crop P)
issues.what: the thin inner ringlets pinch together, wobble, and fold in wavy ripples rather than smooth concentric ellipses, while the brighter upper-left ring band in crop A shows diagonal ribbed pixelation
issues.fix: render the rings from true concentric 3D ring geometry with anti-aliased radial opacity/albedo sampling instead of a warped 2D layer or undersampled radial shader

issues.where: bright right planetary limb in crop V (also image-05.png lower-right limb and image-06.png crops A, E, and I)
issues.what: regular horizontal scanline-like ribs and jagged pixel steps cut into both the outer horizon edge and the bright cyan-white limb gradient
issues.fix: increase sphere tessellation, atmospheric raymarch step count, and anti-aliasing along the limb so the rim falloff and silhouette curve smoothly

issues.where: Milky Way dust bands in crops E, F, and H (also image-01.png right sky and image-03.png crop Q)
issues.what: the background Milky Way nebula texture looks soft and slightly blocky at native size compared with the crisp single-pixel foreground stars and sharp rings
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution skybox plate or sharper procedural dust and unresolved starfield detail to match the foreground rendering resolution

issues.where: sunlit globe in crop A and dark right/bottom limb in crop E (also image-03.png crop P and image-04.png crops T and U)
issues.what: isolated single-pixel white noise speckles dot the smooth cyan atmosphere in crop A, and the nightside limb meets the starfield along a slightly jagged 1-pixel stair-stepped edge
issues.fix: remove bright firefly/star-bleed pixels from the sunlit globe shader and soften/anti-alias the dark limb silhouette and thin nightside rim line

issues.where: lower-left starfield in crops S and T (also image-02.png crop D lower-left)
issues.what: stars near the lower-left corner stretch into soft diagonal oval blobs and faint isolated rainbow lens smudges appear in empty dark sky
issues.fix: reduce corner coma/chromatic distortion on the starfield and remove stray low-opacity chromatic flare patches

issues.where: tiles A, E, and I, sunlit cloud decks
issues.what: clouds are diagonally stretched and airbrushed, soft smeared bands rather than sharp filaments or cells
issues.fix: add multi-scale turbulence and remove the directional smear so native crops resolve cloud edges

issues.where: tiles U and V, lower sunlit atmosphere
issues.what: the near surface is a blurred wash, one faint smudge over a flat gradient, with no structural detail
issues.fix: carry fine cloud structure into the lower frame instead of a soft directional smear

issues.where: tiles C, E, F, and I, pole through lower disk
issues.what: the disk is vertically brushed and nearly featureless beside sharp ring shadows, so the surface looks painted; polar wisps are softer than those shadows
issues.fix: break the vertical streaks into smaller cloud structure across the disk, and sharpen polar turbulence to match the ring shadows

issues.what: the body stays a low-frequency airbrushed gradient with only faint longitudinal streaks
issues.fix: add interior cloud relief on the central disk so it is not a smooth fill

issues.where: tiles S and T, lower-left nightside
issues.what: flat near-black fill with almost no cloud relief
issues.fix: keep the shadow dark but add faint structure so it is not a flat fill
